t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The colours of the hats and baskets can indicate who has the most.

vb_textbox.text: red, pink, purple and dark brown have red basketsyellow, blue, green and light brown have yellow basketsStart by choosing a random side, if the pay out is less than 5 on 1x or 10 on 5x choose the other colours of gnomes. Switch when the side you chose stops paying high rates.
